standard_prerequisites: I-adic completions and the henselization of a Noetherian pair as a filtered colimit of etale algebras preserving the reduction
the cotangent complex exact sequence for compositions and the annihilation of its cohomology in the rig-etale case
idempotent-quotient lemma identifying a surjective completion with the completion of a finite type algebra
the universal property of the henselization
core_obligations: Prove that for B finite type over A, etale over Spec(A) minus V(I), every A-algebra map B^wedge to C^wedge of I-adic completions comes from a unique A-algebra map B to C^h, and every A-algebra map B to C^h factors through an etale C-algebra C' with C/IC isomorphic to C'/IC'
proof_roadmap: Uniqueness holds since C^h embeds in C^wedge, and the final factorization assertion holds since C^h is the filtered colimit of etale deformations C' of C/IC
For existence, a map B^wedge to C^wedge gives a section of the completion of C to B tensor_A C; replacing the quadruple by (C, IC, B tensor C, C, sigma) reduces to the case A = C

Then B^wedge to A^wedge is surjective; rig-etale plus the NL exact sequence annihilate the cohomology of the completed cotangent complex by a power of I, so the kernel's square is likewise annihilated, and the idempotent-quotient lemma realizes the map as the completion of a finite type B-algebra D with A^wedge to D^wedge an isomorphism

After localizing, A to D is etale away from V(I), and the isomorphism on completions makes it etale near V(I) by the infinitesimal-neighbourhood criterion, hence etale; so D maps to A^h, finishing the existence proof
difficulty_reason: H2: a base-change reduction plus a cotangent-complex annihilation argument; the source carries all four moves explicitly.
